title: SpiderMark: Hybrid Watermarking for Generative AI via Algorithmic Injection and Learning-Based Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.24200v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The proliferation of diffusion-based generative models has intensified the need for reliable methods to trace and verify the provenance of AI-generated images. Existing watermarking approaches for diffusion models typically rely on isotropic frequency patterns and handcrafted detection metrics, which are prone to directional vulnerability and threshold instability across diverse image transformations. We propose SpiderMark, a hybrid watermarking framework that combines algorithmic frequency-domain injection with learning-based probabilistic verification, requiring no modifications to pretrained diffusion model weights. SpiderMark embeds a structured spider-web pattern, comprising radial spokes and concentric polygonal rings, into the Fourier representation of the initial latent noise, and trains a lightweight ResNet-18 verifier augmented with auxiliary similarity cues (PSNR and L1) to produce a continuous watermark confidence score for

translated_title: SpiderMark：通过算法注入与基于学习的验证实现生成式AI的混合水印框架
translated_abstract: 基于扩散模型的生成式模型的快速发展，加剧了对可靠方法的需求，以便追踪和验证AI生成图像的来源。现有的针对扩散模型的水印方法通常依赖于各向同性的频率模式和手工设计的检测指标，这些方法容易受到方向性脆弱性的影响，并且在各种图像变换下存在阈值不稳定的问题。我们提出了SpiderMark，一种混合水印框架，它将算法频域注入与基于学习的概率验证相结合，无需修改预训练扩散模型的权重。SpiderMark在初始潜在噪声的傅里叶表示中嵌入一种结构化的蜘蛛网图案（由径向辐条和同心多边形环组成），并训练一个轻量级的ResNet-18验证器，该验证器通过辅助相似性线索（PSNR和L1）进行增强，以产生连续的水印置信度分数……
tldr: SpiderMark提出了一种无需修改预训练扩散模型权重的混合水印框架，通过在初始潜在噪声的傅里叶表示中注入结构化蜘蛛网图案，并结合轻量级学习验证器生成连续水印置信度分数，实现了对AI生成图像更鲁棒的溯源与验证。
en_tdlr: SpiderMark is a hybrid watermarking framework that embeds a structured spider-web pattern into the Fourier representation of initial latent noise without modifying pretrained diffusion model weights, and uses a lightweight learning-based verifier to produce continuous watermark confidence scores for robust provenance tracing of AI-generated images.
